findings.title: PostgreSQL Transaction Limitation on ADD VALUE Reference within DDL
findings.evidence: In PostgreSQL, a newly added enum value from 'ALTER TYPE ... ADD VALUE' cannot be referenced in the same transaction block as a column default in subsequent DDL statements (PostgreSQL error: 'unsafe use of new value in transaction').
findings.exploitability_impact: Medium migration failure risk. Running prisma migrate deploy would fail when executing the migration transaction block if referencing the newly added enum value in table DDL defaults.
findings.before_behavior: Attempting to ALTER TABLE conceptual_questions ADD COLUMN question_type with default 'SINGLE_CORRECT' in the same script block as ALTER TYPE QuestionType ADD VALUE 'SINGLE_CORRECT'.
findings.after_behavior: Migration 8 defines the column default as 'SINGLE_CHOICE' (an existing enum value) in the DDL block, then updates rows, while Prisma schema and client seamlessly map and handle canonical 'SINGLE_CORRECT' values in application code.
findings.remediation: Structured migration 8 DDL to use the existing enum literal for default assignment during transactional migration, ensuring 100% idempotent execution on PostgreSQL.

findings.title: Zod 4 Issue Mapping Type Incompatibility in SuperRefine
findings.evidence: In Zod 4.6.5, ctx.addIssue(issue) expects an explicit issue structure or custom issue descriptor, rather than raw internal $ZodIssue objects from safeParse.
findings.exploitability_impact: Low TypeScript build failure. Prevented tsc --noEmit from succeeding during CI/preflight checks.
findings.after_behavior: Mapped issues to structured custom issues with explicit code: 'custom', message, and path array.

findings.title: Admin Service Parameter Typing Bound to Restricted SessionPrismaClient
